mapper.select: SELECT id, work_type AS workType, work_id AS workId, user_id AS userId, user_name AS userName, content, created_at AS createdAt FROM work_comment WHERE work_type = #{workType} AND work_id = #{workId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_comment (work_type, work_id, user_id, user_name, content, created_at) VALUES (#{workType}, #{workId}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{content}, #{createdAt})
